description: Quectel EP06 / EG06 / EM06 (2c7c:0306, LTE-A Cat.6): DIAG 0, NMEA 1, AT 2 primary, 3 AT/PPP, network function after them (QMI by default; ModemManager's rules name ports 0-3 for this PID whatever the usbnet mode, but a usbnet change re-enumerates and was field-reported to lose the AT port and the data interface on one host). EP06-E / EG06-E: USSD is not supported by the firmware (AT+CUSD answers OK, no network answer ever comes); not generalised to EP06-A, which shares the PID. SIM slots: two, reported by QMI UIM and ModemManager; AT+QUIMSLOT does not answer on this model (that is the EM12/RM5xx command). Band tables differ per firmware under the same PID; legacy AT+QCFG="band" / "nwscanmode" (0 auto, 2 WCDMA, 3 LTE on EP06-E), not QNWPREFCFG
